## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`objectstack-automation` 技能的 `notify` 小节新增三行,教三个收件人选择器:`team:ID`、`owner_of:OBJECT:ID`、`org:members`;另加一条 eval(第 22 条),要求全组织公告写 `recipients: 'org:members'`。
- **为什么改**:PR #32782 已把 `org:members` 落到 `main`,但技能只教「id、列表、表达式」,AI 写公告流程时会手工罗列用户。
- **风险与回滚**:只改技能文案和 eval,不动任何包代码。token 6854 → 6861(上限 6861,未抬);删减为 8 处,其中 3 处是合并 #32839 之后新补的。 回滚即撤这个 PR。
- **先看**:`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` 的 `notify` 小节新增的三行;同文件 `Failure routing & runAs` 里两处删减(`readonly` 段、hook 段末句);`evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` 第 22 条。
- **两分钟验证**:对照 `packages/services/service-messaging/src/recipient-resolver.ts` 的 `resolveOne`(`team:`、`org:`、`owner_of:` 三个分支),应与新增三行一致。
- **需要你做的**:批准这个 Tier H PR(`skills/**` 需受管审批人批准),之后席位落地。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, section `### notify`: one lead-in line and three list lines after the example, naming the selectors a recipient string may be, written or evaluated.

- `team:ID`: that team's members.
- `owner_of:OBJECT:ID`: that record's owner.
- `org:members`: every member of the run's organization, else that of the record the notification is about; any other `org:` value reaches nobody, with a warning.

Three of the eight deletions at `752d4d53` were already spent on `main` by PR #32839 (the fault-edge "`type: 'fault'` is what routes", Filter operands "a literal or a CEL envelope", item 4 "write the `value` in the `condition` AND every `fields` / `filter` entry"), so they pay nothing here. This PR's own deletions against `main` `522882ab` are eight:

| Where | Deleted | Bytes | Still said by |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `### Flow Node Types` lead-in | "Flows are built from built-in node types" | 36 | its own heading |
| External Integration table, `notify` row | "through the messaging service" | 22 | the `messaging` row of the `requires` table |
| External Integration table, `script` row | "named by `config.function`" | 31 | *Valid-but-silently-wrong* item 3 |
| `readonly` note | "so a flow maintaining one runs `runAs: 'system'`" (the three examples stay) | 53 | the note's own heading |
| hook `runAs` note | "`sudo` is not a hook key." | 26 | the note's own heading |
| `### Flow Variables` (new) | "of `{ name, type, isInput, isOutput }` entries" | 47 | the example in the same sentence, which spells all four keys |
| `script` example in item 3 (new) | the trailing comment "returns { ai_category, ai_sentiment, … }" | 50 | item 3: "returns a value; `config.outputVariable` exposes that value"; the `source: 'ai.ai_category'` line; the `defineStack({ functions })` example |
| *Valid-but-silently-wrong* lead-in (new) | "Legal metadata authors get wrong; most" becomes "Most" | 34 | the section heading |

Added: 324 bytes (the lead-in and three selector lines). Deleted: 299 bytes. Net +25 bytes.

`skills/objectstack-automation/evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json`: case 22, an administrator-started announcement to the whole organization. It must contain `notify` and `recipients: 'org:members'`, and must not contain `objectName: 'sys_member'` or `objectName: 'sys_user'`.

`.changeset/32785-notify-audience-selectors.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`.

## Why

PR #32782 added the `org:members` audience (`Metadata-protocol: added`) and left this skill as an owed follow-up. The section taught a recipient as an id, a list, an envelope or `emailField` only.

Each selector was read on `origin/main` `2ca09de5`:

- `packages/services/service-messaging/src/recipient-resolver.ts`, `resolveOne`: `team:` reads the `sys_team_member` rows whose `team_id` is the value; `owner_of:OBJECT:ID` reads that record's owner field; `org:members` reads every `sys_member` of the emitting organization, and any other value under `org:` warns and resolves to nobody.
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts`: the organization is the run's (`context.tenantId`), else `organizationOfRecordAbout`. A string an envelope evaluates to takes the same path as a written one, which is why the lead-in says "written or evaluated".
- `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`, the paragraph "A `notify` node's recipients: a list adds each recipient", says the same. The new lines follow its wording.

## Tests

Skill prose and one eval case; no package code changed, so no test or ablation applies. The `notify` example fence is not touched.

## Acceptance notes

- **Readings (skills/\*\*), `main` `522882ab` to head `e41a68aa`.** `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`: 467 → 473 lines, 27436 → 27461 bytes, 6854 → 6861 tokens (ceiling 6861, headroom 7 → 0; no ceiling raised). Bundle, sum of every `skills/*/SKILL.md`: 4604 → 4610 lines. Bundle token total (whole shipped tree): 243893.
- **Line budget.** The card allows about 6 net lines; this is 4 net (6 added in the `notify` section, 2 removed by the deletions).
- **`owner_of:` stays one clause.** The resolver reads the first set field of `owner_id`, `assigned_to`, `assignee_id`, `owner`, `assignee`. The line says "that record's owner" and does not list the fields; the documentation does not list them either.
- **No `role:` selector is taught.** The card names three selectors, and the documentation's word rule (`check:role-word`) covers `skills/**`.
- **#32776** edits the same file's Inbound webhook section. This PR does not touch that section. Whichever lands second merges `main` and re-runs `check-skills-token-ratchet`; this PR leaves 4 tokens of headroom.

Two of them (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`) first exited 3, prerequisite not met, with only spec, formula and lint built; they exited 0 after a whole-tree `pnpm build --concurrency=2` under `os-verify-lock` (119 tasks, VERDICT command-exit 0), and `check:dts-closure`, `check:published-files` and `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` were run again on that build, exit 0. `check-skills-token-ratchet`: `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` 6857 / 6861.
